name: compiler_codegen
hypothesis: Base: existing-sme, SHA-256 3719c58530161598ab9a537a43be749a5287c8d8dbd35b855e5afea97cd15258. Add two SME2 paired operand loads per reduction step only for full n=512 tiles. Preserve the four FP32 MOPAs, selectors 0–3, predicates, increasing-k accumulation, direct ZA stores, transpose, and general fallback. The supplied baseline assembly uses four individual loads; the supplied probe emits two paired loads. This distinct source is absent from the supplied history. Fewer load instructions may improve throughput, but no gain is established. Candidate compilation, hot-loop assembly and spill inspection, full-GEMM correctness at tolerance 0.002, tail and guard checks, and fresh repeated paired AC measurements remain pending. No tools were used; retain the incumbent pending the unchanged acceptance gates.

adjudication.reason: The candidate passed the supplied correctness checks, but eligible=false blocks adoption. Fresh paired trials show throughput losses of 41.7%, 28.4%, and 42.7%. Candidate scores were 891.07–1048.92 GFLOP/s versus controls of 1464.86–1570.95 GFLOP/s. Every candidate result was below every control; the regression exceeds observed repeat variation. Discard this candidate and retain existing-sme. These measurements do not establish the cause of the regression.
